guide.summary: Public agent app, your own Harvest OAuth2 app (self-serve (no review step found in the docs), wait none).
guide.verdict: Public agent app, your own Harvest OAuth2 app (self-serve (no review step found in the docs), wait none).

composio.note: Composio lists Harvest under managed OAuth, so prototypes can start without registering an app. For launch, create a custom auth config with your own client ID and secret.

need_own_app.answer: Not for prototypes, because Composio provides a managed Harvest app. For production you should bring your own app so users see your app name rather than Composio's, and to avoid sharing quota with other Composio users.
reasons: Consent screen shows your brand instead of 'Composio wants to access your account'
Managed apps share rate-limit quota across all Composio users
Custom auth config lets you control scopes and polling intervals
Managed auth enforces a 15-minute minimum polling interval for triggers

scenarios.label: Public agent app, your own Harvest OAuth2 app
scenarios.when_this_applies: Your agent connects many customers' Harvest accounts through an OAuth2 app you created in Harvest ID.

hands_on.basis: estimate from step count, not measured; app creation is described in c2

waiting.basis: The Harvest docs describe no review or approval step; no timeline was found.

scenarios.approval: No provider review is described in the Harvest docs. Users authorize their own accounts through Harvest ID.

prerequisites.title: Harvest ID account with Developers access
prerequisites.detail: The OAuth2 app is created from the Developers section of Harvest ID; no plan or region requirement was named. Older v1 docs say registration needs an Administrator on the Harvest account.

prerequisites.title: Decide product scope and account mode
prerequisites.detail: Choose Harvest, Forecast or both, and whether the app supports multiple accounts or just one. Pick the minimal scope.

steps.title: Copy redirect URI from Composio dashboard
steps.detail: Open the Composio dashboard, start a custom auth config for the harvest toolkit and copy the redirect URI it shows.
steps.done_when: You have the Composio redirect URI.

steps.title: Create the OAuth2 app in Harvest ID
steps.detail: In the Developers section of Harvest ID, enter the app name, product scope, multi-account setting and the Redirect URL.
steps.done_when: Harvest shows a client ID and client secret.

steps.title: Create Composio auth config via API
steps.detail: Create the harvest auth config with your own client ID and secret, then check that the redirect URI matches what is registered in Harvest.
steps.done_when: The auth config exists and its redirect URI matches the Harvest app.

steps.title: Test a connection end to end
steps.detail: Connect a test Harvest account through Composio and confirm the consent screen shows your app name and the right accounts.
steps.done_when: A connected account is created and a test call succeeds.

steps.title: Optional: submit Harvest integration listing
steps.detail: Harvest has a separate listing form asking for product name, tagline, introduction, logo and screenshots. It is not described as required to connect users.

traps.title: Access tokens expire after 18 hours
traps.detail: Harvest docs say each user's token expires after 18 hours (stated generally, from the OAuth 2.0 doc). Plan for token refresh or re-authorization, and confirm in testing.

traps.title: Rate limits can block the whole account
traps.detail: General calls are limited to 100 per 15 seconds and Reports calls to 100 per 15 minutes. Exceeding them returns HTTP 429, and the throttle can block accounts.

traps.title: Managed app is not for production
traps.detail: Users see 'Composio wants to access your account', and quota is shared across all Composio users.

traps.title: Redirect URI must start with the registered URL
traps.detail: A redirect_uri passed at authorization can only customize the registered Redirect URL by extending it.

traps.title: Do not follow v1 docs
traps.detail: The v1 API is deprecated and gets no technical support. Use the v2 docs and the Harvest ID flow.

blockers.symptom: Redirect URI rejected or mismatch during authorization
blockers.what_it_means: The redirect_uri does not start with the Redirect URL registered in the Harvest app.
blockers.what_to_do: Update the Redirect URL in Harvest ID to the one from the Composio dashboard.
blockers.agent_can_help: Compare the Composio redirect URI with the registered one and flag differences.

blockers.what_it_means: A rate limit was exceeded; the Retry-After header gives seconds until the throttle lifts.
blockers.what_to_do: Back off, cache responses where possible and respect Retry-After.
blockers.agent_can_help: Add retry and backoff logic to the agent's tool calls.

open_questions: Does Harvest review or approve OAuth2 apps before outside customers connect? The v2 docs describe none; confirm by asking Harvest support or testing with a second company's account.
Is the integration listing required or only optional? Ask Harvest through the integration submission form.
Does the 18-hour token expiry apply to v2 and are refresh tokens supported? Check the v2 authentication docs or test it.
Does creating an app in Harvest ID need an Administrator role in v2? Only the v1 docs say so; try with a non-admin account.
